267.description_text: Thermo is your secret weapon for unlocking your body's full potential. Turn up the heat on your fitness journey with our thermogenic fat-burning powder designed to incinerate stubborn fat, boost energy levels, and enhance focus. Say hello to a leaner, more energized you. Results you can feel, every step of the way. † Thermo is your secret weapon for unlocking your body's full potential. Turn up the heat on your fitness journey with our thermogenic fat-burning powder designed to incinerate stubborn fat, boost energy levels, and enhance focus. Say hello to a leaner, more energized you. Results you can feel, every step of the way. † VIEW SUPPLEMENT FACTS VIEW SUPPLEMENT FACTS VIEW SUPPLEMENT FACTS What's In Thermo? (A Glossary of Ingredients) Overview Thermo is your secret weapon for unlocking your body's full potential. Turn up the heat on your fitness journey with our thermogenic fat-burning powder designed to incinerate stubborn fat, boost energy levels, and enhance focus. Say hello to a leaner, more energized you. Results you can feel, every step of the way. † Chromax Chromax® is a mineral that plays an important role in your body’s ability to manage blood sugar levels. Essentially, chromium helps your body use insulin more effectively, which can help balance blood sugar and help with energy production. It’s often included in supplements because it helps curb cravings, especially for carbs.† Taurine Taurine helps regulate the balance of fluids in your cells, ensuring they stay hydrated and function properly. In the brain, taurine has calming effects, which can help with mood and mental clarity.† SunPS SunPS®is a natural compound found in the brain. It helps keep your brain sharp by improving memory, focus, and mental clarity, while also lowering stress by reducing cortisol levels. Think of it as a brain booster that helps you stay calm, focused, and perform at your best.† Innoslim InnoSlim® supports weight management by improving insulin sensitivity and enhancing glucose uptake in muscle cells, which helps your body use sugar for energy instead of storing it as fat. In addition, it helps regulate blood sugar levels, preventing fat storage and promoting the breakdown of fat for fuel.† PurCaf PurCaf® is a natural caffeine source made from organic green coffee beans. It gives you a smooth, sustained energy boost without the crash or jitters that come with synthetic caffeine. Since it's plant-based and free from artificial additives, it's a cleaner option for staying energized. † Dandelion Root Extract Dandelion Root Extract is a natural diuretic that helps your body shed excess water weight, leaving you feeling less bloated and more toned. It works by promoting the elimination of retained fluids, which can be especially helpful during weight management or when aiming for a leaner look.† CapsiBurn CapsiBurn® is a fiery ingredient that turns up the heat on your metabolism. It works through a process called thermogenesis, where the active compound capsaicin helps increase your body’s core temperature and calorie-burning rate. This not only supports fat oxidation but can also enhance energy expenditure, making it easier to shed stubborn fat. Beyond its metabolic benefits, CapsiBurn® can help curb appetite, keeping those snack cravings in check.† Paradoxine Paradoxin®, made from grains of paradise, is a natural ingredient that helps turn up your body’s fat-burning potential. It works by activating brown adipose tissue, a type of fat that burns calories to generate heat. It’s also been shown to support healthy blood sugar levels and may even help control appetite.† Fucoxanthin Fucoxanthin works in two key ways: by promoting fat oxidation and boosting thermogenesis. By enhancing thermogenesis, fucoxanthin helps your body burn more calories throughout the day, even when you're not actively exercising. † Theobromine HCl Theobromine is a stimulant that helps with cognitive function, weight management and athletic performance. It improves concentration and attention as well as improving breathing and reduces fatigue. Theobromine helps with weight management by boosting your metabolism and reducing oxidative stress. † Acetyl L-Carnitine Acetyl L-Carnitine HCl helps your body convert fat into energy, so you’re not just burning fuel- you’re tapping into stored fat as an energy source during your workout, giving you both mental and physical stamina. This form of L-Carnitine crosses the blood-brain barrier, meaning it can also support mental focus and clarity.† L-Tyrosine L-Tyrosine serves as a precursor to several important neurotransmitters, including dopamine and adrenaline- basically the stuff that keeps you feeling focused and in a good mood. It helps to reduce stress, sharpen your mind and keep you alert so you maximize your workouts.† NeuroRush NeuroRush™ utilizes Coffea Arabica Extract to boost cognitive function, mood, and vitality, while also supporting neuroprotection. It is rich in chlorogenic acids, also known as CGA, and can enhance reaction time, alertness, and memory, making it a reliable choice for optimizing brain health and function. † ProSupps Brand Promise Our dedication to quality and integrity means that we never cut corners, and we always put your health and performance FIRST. Our products contain zero fillers, zero banned substances and zero FD&C dyes. Every ProSupps product goes through rigorous third-party testing for purity, efficacy and transparency. EVERY BATCH. EVERY TIME. (A Glossary of Ingredients) Overview Introducing Mr. HYDE Xtreme, the most hard-hitting pre-workout supplement you'll ever experience. Packed with a combination of HIGH stim & focus ingredients to deliver an immediate surge of energy, in a true one-serving formula. Loaded with 462.5mg of hard-hitting stim matrix and added Yohimbe for immediate energy, plus a 904.5mg Intensity Matrix, Mr. HYDE Xtreme delivers explosive power that will have you crushing through plateaus (or walls).† Beta-Alanine Beta-Alanine helps to regulate the lactic acid build up in the muscle to reduce exercise fatigue. This means you can push harder and hit more reps in the gym. Beta-Alanine is also responsible for the tingle sensation that most users experience when taking a pre-workout. But don’t worry, it goes away after a few minutes.† Nitrosigine® Nitrosigine is a patented complex of bonded . It has been clinically studied and proven to boosts nitric oxide levels, improving blood flow and vascularity, giving you better pumps. It supports oxygen and nutrient delivery to the muscles, improving exercise performance and endurance. † L-Citrulline L-Citrulline is an amino acid that boosts nitric oxide production- the molecule responsible for dilating blood vessels. This process increases blood flow, which helps to improve nutrient transport and supply the muscles with fresh blood and oxygen during exercise, improving endurance, pumps and recovery. † Creatine HCl Creatine HCl is one of the most studied ingredients in Sports nutrition and has been proven to boost muscle power and strength, as well improve muscle recovery and growth. For creatine to be effective, your muscles need to be saturated with it, so taking it consistently overtime will maximize results. † Choline Bitartrate Choline Bitartrate helps to improve the communication between your nervous system and your muscles, so you perform better and more efficiently. It’s the brain fuel you need to stay focused, improve cognitive function and muscle contraction during exercise.† L-Theanine L-Theanine is an amino acid known for its calming effects- it works by helping take the edge off any pre-workout jitters and supporting focus- making it important for the high caffeine content of Hyde Xtreme, so you are not only energized, but also dialed in..† N-Acetyl Tyrosine L-Tyrosine serves as a precursor to several important neurotransmitters, including dopamine and adrenaline- basically the stuff that keeps you feeling focused and in a good mood. It helps to reduce stress, sharpen your mind and keep you alert so you maximize your workouts. N-Acetyl Tyrosine is more bioavailable and more soluble in water, which means your body can absorb and use it better.† GABA GABA is a neurotransmitter that helps reduce neuron activity and lowers stress responses, helping you keep calm under pressure. It works to balance out any overstimulation, keeping you focused and in control, without feeling jittery or anxious..† Yohimbe Bark Extract Yohimbe is derived from the bark of the Yohimbe tree, you may also see it as yohimbine which is the active compound in Yohimbe bark. In supplementation, it is commonly used for improving sexual function, promoting weight loss, or boosting energy and athletic performance.† Caffeine Anhydrous Caffeine Anhydrous is a concentrated form of caffeine that’s all about quick, powerful energy. Caffeine Anhydrous is essentially caffeine without water, so it’s absorbed faster, giving you that boost right when you need it. It's perfect for firing up your energy, focus, and motivation at the start of your workout. It helps you power through tough sets, increases endurance, and keeps you mentally sharp without going overboard. † Di-Caffeine Malate Di-Caffeine Malate combines caffeine with Malic Acid, which helps it release more gradually, giving you a smoother, longer-lasting energy boost. It is the perfect complement to Caffeine Anhydrous, giving you both an immediate kick and balanced energy.† Caffeine Citric Acid Blend Caffeine Citric Acid Blend is a unique combo of caffeine anhydrous and citric acid that gives you a faster, smoother energy boost. The citric acid helps speed up the absorption of caffeine. When paired with Caffeine Anhydrous like in Hyde Xtreme, this blend ensures you get both an instant spark and sustained energy. † ProSupps Brand Promise Our dedication to quality and integrity means that we never cut corners, and we always put your health and performance FIRST. Our products contain zero fillers, zero banned substances and zero FD&C dyes. Every ProSupps product goes through rigorous third-party testing for purity, efficacy and transparency. EVERY BATCH. EVERY TIME.
